issuing_body: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan
covered_actors: AI利用者 (AI users / businesses using AI services)
implementation_notes: This document is a practical contract checklist published by METI in February 2025, aimed at businesses engaging in AI utilization and development. It is non-binding guidance to assist businesses—especially those unfamiliar with AI legal practice—in reviewing contract terms related to inputs, outputs, personal data handling under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), security, and log retention. It references the 'AI事業者ガイドライン' (AI Business Operator Guidelines v1.01, November 2024) and the prior 2019 'AI・データの利用に関する契約ガイドライン'. No penalties or enforcement authorities are named; the document is purely advisory.
